  <!-- RETAIL-LINKED DEBUG. The target is a RETAIL/RGH console, not a devkit, so this config links the
       RETAIL Xbox 360 system libraries (d3d9.lib, xapilib.lib, ...) and the retail static CRT, NEVER the
       *d.lib debug runtimes. The debug D3D/XAM/audio runtimes require devkit-only kernel services; on a
       retail console they either fail to init or (in an emulator) trip validation asserts like
       "*VdGlobalDevice == NULL". App-level debugging is a SEPARATE axis: J2X_DEBUG turns on our own trace
       log / HeapTrack (see companions/Common.h) with ZERO dependency on Microsoft's _DEBUG libraries.
       Kept debuggable via Optimization=Disabled + full PDB. See notes/01-architecture-and-lifecycle.md. -->
  <ItemDefinitionGroup Condition="'$(Configuration)|$(Platform)'=='Debug|Xbox 360'">
    <ClCompile>
      <PrecompiledHeader>Use</PrecompiledHeader>
      <WarningLevel>Level3</WarningLevel>
      <DebugInformationFormat>ProgramDatabase</DebugInformationFormat>
      <Optimization>Disabled</Optimization>
      <ExceptionHandling>Sync</ExceptionHandling>
      <RuntimeTypeInfo>true</RuntimeTypeInfo>
      <MinimalRebuild>true</MinimalRebuild>
      <BufferSecurityCheck>false</BufferSecurityCheck>
      <PrecompiledHeaderOutputFile>$(OutDir)$(ProjectName).pch</PrecompiledHeaderOutputFile>
      <RuntimeLibrary>MultiThreaded</RuntimeLibrary>
      <PreprocessorDefinitions>NDEBUG;_XBOX;J2X_DEBUG</PreprocessorDefinitions>
    </ClCompile>
    <Link>
      <GenerateDebugInformation>true</GenerateDebugInformation>
      <ProgramDatabaseFile>$(OutDir)$(ProjectName).pdb</ProgramDatabaseFile>
      <AdditionalDependencies>xuihtml.lib;xuirun.lib;xuirender.lib;xapilib.lib;d3d9.lib;d3dx9.lib;xgraphics.lib;xboxkrnl.lib;xnet.lib;xaudio2.lib;xact3.lib;x3daudio.lib;xmcore.lib;vcomp.lib;xinput2.lib</AdditionalDependencies>
    </Link>
  </ItemDefinitionGroup>
  <!-- CodeAnalysis: PREfast static analysis. Also retail-linked (same rationale as Debug above) so an
       accidental deploy of this config still runs on a retail/RGH console. J2X_DEBUG keeps app tracing on. -->
  <ItemDefinitionGroup Condition="'$(Configuration)|$(Platform)'=='CodeAnalysis|Xbox 360'">
    <ClCompile>
      <PrecompiledHeader>Use</PrecompiledHeader>

      <DebugInformationFormat>ProgramDatabase</DebugInformationFormat>

  <!-- RETAIL-LINKED DEBUG. The target is a RETAIL/RGH console, not a devkit, so this config links the
       RETAIL Xbox 360 system libraries (d3d9.lib, xapilib.lib, ...) and the retail static CRT, NEVER the
       *d.lib debug runtimes. The debug D3D/XAM/audio runtimes require devkit-only kernel services; on a
       retail console they either fail to init or (in an emulator) trip validation asserts like
       "*VdGlobalDevice == NULL". App-level debugging is a SEPARATE axis: J2X_DEBUG turns on our own trace
       log / HeapTrack (see companions/Common.h) with ZERO dependency on Microsoft's _DEBUG libraries.
       Kept debuggable via Optimization=Disabled + full PDB. See notes/01-architecture-and-lifecycle.md. -->
  <ItemDefinitionGroup Condition="'$(Configuration)|$(Platform)'=='Debug|Xbox 360'">
    <ClCompile>
      <PrecompiledHeader>Use</PrecompiledHeader>
      <WarningLevel>Level3</WarningLevel>
      <DebugInformationFormat>ProgramDatabase</DebugInformationFormat>
      <Optimization>Disabled</Optimization>
      <ExceptionHandling>Sync</ExceptionHandling>
      <RuntimeTypeInfo>true</RuntimeTypeInfo>
      <MinimalRebuild>true</MinimalRebuild>
      <BufferSecurityCheck>false</BufferSecurityCheck>
      <PrecompiledHeaderOutputFile>$(OutDir)$(ProjectName).pch</PrecompiledHeaderOutputFile>
      <RuntimeLibrary>MultiThreaded</RuntimeLibrary>
      <PreprocessorDefinitions>NDEBUG;_XBOX;J2X_DEBUG</PreprocessorDefinitions>
    </ClCompile>
    <Link>
      <GenerateDebugInformation>true</GenerateDebugInformation>
      <ProgramDatabaseFile>$(OutDir)$(ProjectName).pdb</ProgramDatabaseFile>
      <AdditionalDependencies>xuihtml.lib;xuirun.lib;xuirender.lib;xapilib.lib;d3d9.lib;d3dx9.lib;xgraphics.lib;xboxkrnl.lib;xnet.lib;xaudio2.lib;xact3.lib;x3daudio.lib;xmcore.lib;vcomp.lib;xinput2.lib</AdditionalDependencies>
    </Link>
  </ItemDefinitionGroup>
  <!-- CodeAnalysis: PREfast static analysis. Also retail-linked (same rationale as Debug above) so an
       accidental deploy of this config still runs on a retail/RGH console. J2X_DEBUG keeps app tracing on. -->

  <!-- RETAIL-LINKED DEBUG. The target is a RETAIL/RGH console, not a devkit, so this config links the
       RETAIL Xbox 360 system libraries (d3d9.lib, xapilib.lib, ...) and the retail static CRT, NEVER the
       *d.lib debug runtimes. The debug D3D/XAM/audio runtimes require devkit-only kernel services; on a
       retail console they either fail to init or (in an emulator) trip validation asserts like
       "*VdGlobalDevice == NULL". App-level debugging is a SEPARATE axis: J2X_DEBUG turns on our own trace
       log / HeapTrack (see companions/Common.h) with ZERO dependency on Microsoft's _DEBUG libraries.
       Kept debuggable via Optimization=Disabled + full PDB. See notes/01-architecture-and-lifecycle.md. -->

    <ClCompile>
      <PrecompiledHeader>Use</PrecompiledHeader>

      <Optimization>Disabled</Optimization>
      <ExceptionHandling>Sync</ExceptionHandling>

  <!-- RETAIL-LINKED DEBUG. The target is a RETAIL/RGH console, not a devkit, so this config links the
       RETAIL Xbox 360 system libraries (d3d9.lib, xapilib.lib, ...) and the retail static CRT, NEVER the
       *d.lib debug runtimes. The debug D3D/XAM/audio runtimes require devkit-only kernel services; on a
       retail console they either fail to init or (in an emulator) trip validation asserts like
       "*VdGlobalDevice == NULL". App-level debugging is a SEPARATE axis: J2X_DEBUG turns on our own trace
       log / HeapTrack (see companions/Common.h) with ZERO dependency on Microsoft's _DEBUG libraries.
       Kept debuggable via Optimization=Disabled + full PDB. See notes/01-architecture-and-lifecycle.md. -->
  <ItemDefinitionGroup Condition="'$(Configuration)|$(Platform)'=='Debug|Xbox 360'">
    <ClCompile>
      <PrecompiledHeader>Use</PrecompiledHeader>
      <WarningLevel>Level3</WarningLevel>
      <DebugInformationFormat>ProgramDatabase</DebugInformationFormat>
      <Optimization>Disabled</Optimization>
      <ExceptionHandling>Sync</ExceptionHandling>
      <RuntimeTypeInfo>true</RuntimeTypeInfo>
      <MinimalRebuild>true</MinimalRebuild>
      <BufferSecurityCheck>false</BufferSecurityCheck>
      <PrecompiledHeaderOutputFile>$(OutDir)$(ProjectName).pch</PrecompiledHeaderOutputFile>
      <RuntimeLibrary>MultiThreaded</RuntimeLibrary>
      <PreprocessorDefinitions>NDEBUG;_XBOX;J2X_DEBUG</PreprocessorDefinitions>
    </ClCompile>
    <Link>
      <GenerateDebugInformation>true</GenerateDebugInformation>
      <ProgramDatabaseFile>$(OutDir)$(ProjectName).pdb</ProgramDatabaseFile>
      <AdditionalDependencies>xuihtml.lib;xuirun.lib;xuirender.lib;xapilib.lib;d3d9.lib;d3dx9.lib;xgraphics.lib;xboxkrnl.lib;xnet.lib;xaudio2.lib;xact3.lib;x3daudio.lib;xmcore.lib;vcomp.lib;xinput2.lib</AdditionalDependencies>
    </Link>
  </ItemDefinitionGroup>
